# ExecuTorch as a TEST dependency of the gate (.github/workflows/test.yml), for
# tests/export/test_exir_shim.py (issue #306). Leader decision 2026-11-14: the
# gate may install executorch==1.4.1 plus flatbuffers, ruamel.yaml, tabulate and
# torchao. It is NOT a dependency of the torchnative wheel.
#
# Installed with `pip install --no-deps -r <this file>` into a venv of its own,
# created with --system-site-packages over the gate interpreter, and handed to
# the suite as TORCHNATIVE_EXIR_PYTHON. Two reasons for the shape:
#   - Not in the gate interpreter: tests/devices/qnn/test_qnn.py asserts what a
#     host WITHOUT executorch answers; installing it there changes those tests.
#   - `--no-deps`: executorch's metadata requires coremltools, pandas,
#     scikit-learn, hydra-core and others, none of which is needed. Measured on
#     2026-11-14 with those packages blocked at import: exir, the XNNPACK
#     partitioner, to_edge, to_executorch and to_edge_transform_and_lower all
#     run, and the import closure is these five plus packages the gate already
#     has (numpy, sympy, mpmath, networkx, jinja2, tqdm, typing_extensions).
#
# 1.4.1 is the only version measured in this repository. Its metadata admits
# torch>=2.13.0a0; the vendored tree and the oracle are torch 2.13.0.
executorch==1.4.1
flatbuffers==25.12.19
ruamel.yaml==0.19.1
tabulate==0.10.0
torchao==0.18.0
